αἰετὸς: ἀετός — eagle; masc. nom. sg., epic αἰετός (= Attic ἀετός)
βοηθοΐδης: Βοηθοΐδης — son of Boethous; masc. nom. sg., patronymic (-ίδης), used alone as a name for Eteoneus, Menelaus’s attendant
βούλομαι: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; pres. 1 sg. mid., + inf.: ’I want’
γάμου: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg.: ’of marriage’
γήθησαν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐγήθησαν)
δίδωμι: δίδωμι — give; pres. 1 sg. act.: ’I give’
δαίετο: δαίω (B) — divide, distribute, carve; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐδαίετο): ’was carving’
δεδισκόμενος: δεδίσκομαι (δειδίσκομαι) — greet, welcome with a gesture (sense traditional, uncertain); pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
δεξάμενος: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having received’
δεξιτερῆφι: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg. with the suffix -φι (= Attic δεξιᾷ): ’in the right (hand)’
δεξιὸς: δεξιός — right, on the right, auspicious; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄρνις: ’on the right’ · also masc. nom. sg., predicative, of motion: ’darting up on the right’
δῶρόν: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented because the enclitic τοι follows: ’a gift’
εἰπόντι: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. act., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with οἱ: ’to him as he spoke’
εἴποιμ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. act. 1 sg., elided (εἴποιμ’ = εἴποιμι), optative of wish: ’I might say’
θῆκ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (θῆκ’ = θῆκε, = Attic ἔθηκε): ’set down’
κάμεν: κάμνω — toil, work at, make with toil; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔκαμεν): ’wrought’
καλλιπάρῃος: καλλιπάρῃος — fair-cheeked; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., epic -ῃος, from παρῃά ’cheek’ (Attic παρειά); epithet of Helen
καταλέξομεν: καταλέγω — recount, tell in full; fut. 1 pl. act. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’we shall tell’
κείσθω: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it lie’
κηώεντα: κηώεις — fragrant (traditional gloss, origin uncertain); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θάλαμον
κιοίτην: κίω — go, go one’s way; pres. opt. 3 dual (= Attic -οίτην), secondary dual ending -την: ’the two might go’
κιχὼν: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg. (epic aor. ἔκιχον): ’having found’
κρεῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., partitive with ὀπτῆσαι: ’some of the meat’
κῆαι: καίω — burn, kindle; aor. inf. act., epic (= Attic καῦσαι): ’to kindle’
λάβεν: λαμβάνω — take; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔλαβεν)
λείψαντε: λείβω — pour, pour a libation; aor. part. act., masc. nom. dual: ’having poured a libation’
μεγαπένθε: Μεγαπένθης — Megapenthes, son of Menelaus; masc. acc. sg., elided (Μεγαπένθε’ = Μεγαπένθεα)
μνῆμ: μνῆμα — keepsake, memorial; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (μνῆμ’ = μνῆμα), in apposition to δῶρον
νείατος: νείατος (= νέατος) — undermost, last, lowest; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic νει- (= νέατος), + gen.: ’lowest of the others’
νεῖσθαι: νέομαι — go, come back, return; pres. inf. mid.: ’to go home’
οἰνοχόει: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, serve wine; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ᾠνοχόει)
πέπλον: πέπλος — robe, woman’s garment; masc. acc. sg.
παμποίκιλοι: παμποίκιλος — all-varied, richly embroidered; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. pl., agreeing with πέπλοι
πείρινθα: πείρινς — wicker basket, the body of a wagon or chariot (sense traditional); fem. acc. sg., with ἐς: ’into the chariot-box’
ποικίλμασιν: ποίκιλμα — piece of embroidery, variegated work; neut. dat. pl., with movable ν, dat. of respect: ’in embroideries’
πολυηράτου: πολυήρατος — much-loved, lovely; adj., masc. gen. sg., agreeing with γάμου
τυχὼν: τυγχάνω — hit upon, obtain, + gen.; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having obtained’
τῆος: τῆος — meanwhile, for so long; adv., epic (= Attic τέως), correlative of ἧος
φαεινὸν: φαεινός — shining, bright (cf. φαίνω ’show, shine’); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρητῆρα
φορέειν: φορέω — carry, wear; pres. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φορεῖν)
φωριαμοῖσιν: φωριαμός — chest, coffer; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀειραμένη: ἀείρω (= αἴρω) — lift, raise, take up; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted: ’having taken up’
ἀπέλαμπεν: ἀπολάμπω — shine forth, gleam; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was gleaming’
ἀπίθησεν: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἀπείθησεν); with οὐκ: ’did not disobey’
ἀργὴν: ἀργός — white, gleaming; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with χῆνα (ἀργός also means swift or idle elsewhere)
ἀρηΐφιλος: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
ἁπάσης: ἅπας — all, the whole; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with φιλότητος
ἐπέπτατο: ἐπιπέτομαι — fly at, fly up to; aor. 3 sg. mid. (ἐπί + ἔπτατο, aorist of πέτομαι): ’flew up’
ἐϋκτίμενον: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον, epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
ἑζέσθην: ἕζομαι — sit down, seat oneself; impf. 3 dual mid. (cf. ἕζοντο): ’the two sat down’
ἔκιε: κίω — go, go one’s way; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented ἔ-: ’went’
ἔφηνε: φαίνω — show, make appear; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’showed, sent as a sign’
ἡμέτερ: ἡμέτερος — our; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἡμέτερ’ = ἡμέτερα), used as a noun: ’our (home)’
ἤϊξε: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented ἤϊ- (= Attic ᾖξε)
ἥμερον: ἥμερος — tame, domesticated; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with χῆνα
ἰΰζοντες: ἰύζω — shout, cry out; pres. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’shouting’
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι)
ὀπτῆσαί: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. inf. act., accented because the enclitic τε follows: ’to roast’
ὄλωμαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. mid. 1 sg. (μή + subj.: ’lest I perish’; = Attic ἀπόλωμαι)
ὑποκρίναιτο: ὑποκρίνομαι — answer, interpret; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., in an indirect question after ὅππως: ’how he might answer’
ὑποφθαμένη: ὑποφθάνω — anticipate, be beforehand; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’getting in first’
ὥρην: ὥρη — season, time (of life); fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ὥραν): ’for the time of marriage’

__broaden__.γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman; fem. nom. pl., in apposition to δμωαί: ’women’ · also fem. nom. pl. in a pair: ’women’ (ἀνέρες ἠδὲ γυναῖκες ’men and women’)
__broaden__.δώματος: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. gen. sg., governed by the adv. εἴσω: ’within the house’ · also gen. sg. governed by διά: ’through the house’ (διὰ δώματος)
__broaden__.οὖρον: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. acc. sg. · also a different word, neut. ’furrow-stretch’, the length a pair of mules ploughs in one go (οὖρον … ἡμιόνοιιν); exact measure unknown · also a different word, οὖρος — warden, guardian (related to ὁράω ’see, watch’); masc. acc. sg. (οὐ … οὖρον … κατέλειπον ’I left no warden behind’)
__broaden__.πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’)
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
__broaden__.χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’ · also gen. pl., dependent on μνῆμα: ’of Helen’s hands’ (μνῆμ’ Ἑλένης χειρῶν ’a memorial of Helen’s hands’)
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’)
__broaden__.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + acc. · also + dat., with anastrophe (χερσὶ ἐφ’ ὕδωρ): ’over, upon (the hands)’ · also + dat. without anastrophe, ’over’ (ἐφ’ αἵματι φάσγανον ἴσχων ’holding the sword over the blood’) · also + acc., ’to, towards’, of destination (ἐφ’ ἡμέτερ’ ’to our (home)’)
__broaden__.ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη) · also neut. acc. sg. relative, referring back to a thing, object of δῶκας: ’which (you gave me)’ · also = ὅτι ’that’, neut. acc. sg., introducing a clause after a verb of knowing (ὃ δὴ κακὰ μήδετο ’that evils were being devised’) · also neut. nom. sg. relative of a thing, subject of ἐστι: ’that which, whatever’ (ὃ κάλλιστον … ἐστι ’the one that is fairest’)
__broaden__.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’)
__broaden__.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’)
